title: Engenheiro de software
description:
Nós da Aliare, unimos o agronegócio em um ambiente de produtividade. Vamos juntos?

Somos a plataforma de cooperação do agronegócio, conectando pessoas, ferramentas e empresas para transformar tempo em produtividade. Existimos para que todos os agentes da cadeia produtiva tenham informações certas, no tempo certo.

A partir da integração, digitalização e inteligência de dados, promovemos uma grande evolução no campo, um setor cada vez mais conectado, com desafios mais complexos, impactando em todo o mundo.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software .NET com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de soluções Cloud Native no ecossistema Azure , capaz de atuar de ponta a ponta, desde o desenho arquitetural até o deploy automatizado em ambientes conteinerizados.


O(a) profissional será uma peça-chave na evolução das nossas soluções enterprise application , com foco em performance, escalabilidade, segurança e observabilidade . Procuramos alguém que pense como arquiteto, desenvolva como engenheiro e apoie o crescimento técnico do time.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar aplicações .NET Core / C# com foco em escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade.
  • Modelar e manter bases de dados relacionais (SQL Server ) e realizar avaliações de performance de queries .
  • Integrar e orquestrar serviços assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ (mensageria) e Redis / Dragonfly (cache/distribuição).
  • Criar pipelines de CI/CD em YAML no Azure DevOps — nada de interface gráfica!
  • Apoiar desenvolvedores em boas práticas de engenharia, design patterns e arquitetura limpa.
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de soluções cloud native , com deploys em Kubernetes (AKS) e provisionamento via Terraform .
  • Implementar práticas de observabilidade com ELK Stack (ElasticSearch, Logstash, Kibana) e métricas de aplicação.
  • Garantir segurança de APIs utilizando JWT, OAuth2 e OpenID Connect (Keycloak, Azure AD, etc.).
  • Participar de revisões arquiteturais e decisões estratégicas sobre evolução tecnológica e cloud.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • +7 anos de experiência com .NET / .NET Core / C# em aplicações corporativas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Azure Cloud , incluindo AKS, Storage e Networking.
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes , Docker , Helm e NGINX ingress controllers .
  • Domínio de SQL Server e PostgreSQL (incluindo tunning, índices, queries complexas, MER).
  • Experiência com RabbitMQ e mensageria distribuída.
  • Vivência em pipelines as code (YAML pipelines no Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions).
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Entendimento de autenticação/autorização moderna (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID).
  • Prática com arquitetura limpa, DDD, SOLID, CQRS e boas práticas de engenharia.


Diferenciais (que farão você se destacar)

  • Experiência com StackGres , Redis/Dragonfly , Elastic Cloud ou Azure Monitor/Log Analytics .
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform Modules e GitOps).
  • Participação em projetos de alta performance e observabilidade distribuída .
  • Perfil colaborativo, capaz de mentorar outros desenvolvedores e influenciar boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Mentalidade de engenheiro de produto — orientado a resultado e impacto no negócio.

O que valorizamos

  • Mentalidade cloud-first e curiosidade por novas tecnologias.
  • Visão arquitetural e pensamento sistêmico.
  • Cultura DevOps e senso de ownership.
  • Comunicação técnica clara e proatividade na resolução de problemas complexos.



Informações adicionais

O que a Aliare proporciona?!

Um time integrado e preparado para novos desafios, que atua com credibilidade e transparência, com objetivo de evoluirmos de forma contínua para facilitar o trabalho de quem alimenta o mundo. Priorizando sempre em nossas ações a ética, o relacionamento, a realização, o comprometimento e inovação.

title: Product Owner
description:
Employment type: Direct Hire – Full-time, with all benefits required by Brazil law

Salary range: Competitive and negotiable based on experience

Language: Bilingual (Advanced English – excellent verbal and written communication skills required)


We are looking for a GRC Analyst to help strengthen the company’s cybersecurity governance program. This role will focus on building a strong security culture, supporting audit readiness, and enhancing vendor risk management. The ideal candidate will combine knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks with strong interpersonal skills to partner effectively across the organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.
  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.
  • Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.
  • Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.
  • Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.
  • Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.
  • Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.
  • Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.



Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience with a revenue management system.
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams , as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • English level: B2 (upper-intermediate) .


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility.
  • Meal Allowance R$ 50.00 per day
  • Life Insurance
  • Health Insurance (Sul America)
  • Transportation Allowance
  • Appreciation Bonus


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Senior Backend Developer – Google Ads API
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Developer – Google Ads API

Company: adMixt (eCommerce Performance Marketing Agency)

Location: Remote

adMixt is hiring a Senior Backend Developer with deep, hands-on experience integrating Google Ads API . This is a senior-level role for someone who has spent years working directly with Google Ads and eCommerce systems to build robust, scalable backend advertising solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain API integrations with Google Ads
  • Work with related APIs such as Shopify, Google Analytics, and attribution platforms
  • Build data pipelines that enable reporting, attribution, and optimization across channels

If you’re passionate about connecting data across platforms and building infrastructure that drives high-impact marketing decisions, we’d love to talk.

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular 2+, HTML, CSS e JavaScript ES6+.
  • Atuar no backend com Java, criação de APIs, microsserviços e soluções em arquitetura monolítica.
  • Modelar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, contribuindo para pipelines de CI/CD e evolução de soluções em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Então essa é a sua chance!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce Sênior (Brasil)
description:
Você na Deloitte

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências. Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Analista de Sistemas no time de Customer , que busca promover inovação e transformação digital em nossos clientes . Na sua rotina, você irá:



  • Liderar projetos de implementação/customização da plataforma Salesforce, desde o planejamento até a entrega e acompanhamento pós-implantação.
  • Levantar requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, converter em especificações técnicas, desenhar soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Desenvolver customizações complexas utilizando Apex, Lightning Components, Flows, Process Builder, etc.
  • Gerenciar integrações entre Salesforce e outras plataformas/serviços (APIs, middleware) garantindo performance, segurança e confiabilidade.
  • Definir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, arquitetura, governança de dados e segurança dentro do ambiente Salesforce.
  • Estruturar e gerir ambientes sandbox, migrar mudanças com deployment seguro, versionamento adequado, qualidade de código.
  • Mentorar e orientar analistas e desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Trabalhar com times multifuncionais (produto, TI, UX) para garantir alinhamento e sucesso das entregas.
  • Garantir que os SLAs internos estejam sendo cumpridos e promover melhorias contínuas nas entregas.



Na Deloitte Digital, conectamos ideias, tecnologias e talentos para impulsionar um futuro melhor para cada um de nós, elevando a experiência humana no desenvolvimento e na transformação dos negócios – de um jeito que só a Deloitte pode fazer.


Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo?

Faz toda diferença contar com quem pode fazer dos sonhos, realidade.



Requisitos obrigatórios:



  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando com Salesforce , envolvimento direto em projetos de médio/grande porte.
  • Certificação Salesforce Administrator obrigatória .
  • Certificação Salesforce App Builder obrigatória .
  • Pelo menos mais uma certificação Salesforce avançada (ex: Platform Developer I ou II, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Architect, etc.).
  • Sólida experiência com Apex, Trigger, Lightning Components (Aura e/ou LWC), Flows.
  • Experiência com integrações via API REST/SOAP, autenticação, segurança de dados.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de arquitetura Salesforce, configuração de segurança (Perfis, Permissões, Sharing Rules), governança de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada com deployments (change sets, Salesforce DX ou ferramentas de versionamento) e ambiente de múltiplos sandboxes.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara, habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas elegantes.



Diferenciais



  • Certificações adicionais como Platform Developer II , Architect (Solution/Technical) ou consultoria especializada em Sales / Service Cloud.
  • Experiência trabalhando com modelagem de dados complexa, grandes volumes de dados, técnicas de otimização de performance.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes regulados ou com requisitos de segurança elevados (por exemplo, LGPD, GDPR).
  • Familiaridade com produtos adicionais do Salesforce (CPQ, Mulesoft, Marketing Cloud, etc.).




O que estará disponível para você?



Desenvolvimento profissional



É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na deloitte! queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com universidade corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, oferecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais da Loitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência . é ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?



Cuidados com o seu bem-estar



Aqui na deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com as pessoas, com equilíbrio entre mente, corpo e propósito. para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:



  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Estratégia familiar: programa destinado a profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terá todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para comemorar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e serviço social



(MAIS) Benefícios



  • Assistência médica e odontológica! para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não pensamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida*
  • Vale refeição / alimentação*



Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva



você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. para fortalecer esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global de d&i com os 5 pilares – origens, delas, lgbt+, inclui e gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público pcd.

description:

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.

Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.

Applications without these will not be considered.

title: Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Pharmacovigilance Business Analyst (PharmaCov BA)

Duration : 6 to 12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion after 6 months.

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Job Title: Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst / Business Analyst

Location: Brazil

The Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst (PV Product Analyst / BA) will act as a strategic liaison between business users, regulatory teams, and IT, ensuring pharmacovigilance (PV) systems and workflows enable accurate, compliant, and efficient adverse event reporting. This role combines strong product ownership responsibilities with deep domain expertise in pharmacovigilance, regulatory compliance, and technology. The analyst will oversee end-to-end product roadmaps, ensure alignment with business needs, and drive platform upgrades, integrations, and compliance.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Product Ownership & Roadmap
  • Own and manage the PV product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
  • Oversee platform maintenance, rebuilding, and tech stack upgrades (e.g., CloudX → KCloud migration).
  • Stay updated on latest pharmacovigilance and product technology trends (AWS, GenAI, SaaS solutions).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Business, Infrastructure, and Leadership teams to plan/manage product releases, downtime, incidents, and upgrades.
  • Serve as the key liaison across regulatory, clinical operations, QA, and IT functions.
  • System Integration & Compliance
  • Oversee safety system integrations (Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety) ensuring accurate data flow and reporting.
  • Ensure Argus acts as the central system, receiving case data from call centers, flowing through safety systems, and reaching regulatory authorities with compliance documentation.
  • Support signal detection and reporting in line with global compliance and regulatory standards (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, GXP, CFR).
  • Monitoring, Debugging & Quality
  • Perform monitoring and debugging for system issues such as unprocessed cases, reconciliation gaps, and data discrepancies.
  • Review AWS logs and system access for issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with QA for system quality checks, validation, and signal monitoring.
  • Analysis & Documentation
  • Gather and analyze requirements for PV systems and workflows.
  • Document processes, data flows, and system functionalities related to adverse event reporting.
  • Support validation and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Provide user training, support, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Strong experience as a Product Analyst or Business Analyst in a regulated environment.
  • Proven knowledge of pharmacovigilance processes and regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with PV safety systems such as Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Required Skills:

  • Familiarity with AWS (for RCA/ debugging), Cloud/SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with JIRA for incident/release management.
  • Experience with validation and UAT in regulated environments.

Tools & Technologies:

  • PV systems: Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Somos mais que um supermercado!


A startup que já economizou mais de R$ 30 milhões a milhares de brasileiros e dobra de tamanho a cada 3 meses, desde sua fundação (em 2015). Em 2021 conseguimos levantar cerca de R$300 milhões em duas rodadas de investimento com gente fora da curva, como José Galló (ex-CEO da Renner), GIC, Ariel Lambrecht (fundador da 99 e da Yellow), Minerva Foods, entre outros. Acreditamos que um país melhor é feito de empresas mais eficientes e de pessoas que trocam velhos hábitos por escolhas mais inteligentes. E trabalhamos por isso. Por essa visão de país melhor, aplicada ao setor que atinge a todos os brasileiros: o setor de produtos essenciais de consumo, mais conhecido como "setor supermercadista". Mas esqueça esse nome: "supermercado". Somos mais que isso. Somos um sistema de reabastecimento. E queremos ser o maior e melhor sistema de reabastecimento do Brasil. Esse é nosso sonho. "Um mundo onde os produtos essenciais cheguem na sua casa com a mesma facilidade que a água chega na torneira".


Quer participar desse sonho com a gente?

Estamos procurando um(a) pessoa Desenvolvedor Full Stack Web - Sênior para desenvolver soluções de alto desempenho. Neste papel, você deve ter habilidades de comunicação e possuir capacidade de priorizar o seu próprio trabalho. Você garantirá que nossas aplicações e sistemas funcionem corretamente e tenham um bom desempenho. A posição é aplicável para trabalhar de maneira remota para os candidatos que residem fora na cidade de São Paulo. Para os candidatos que estão na cidade de São Paulo, a posição seria híbrida, para ir 3x na semana presencial.

  • Desenvolver e implementar funcionalidades alinhadas aos requisitos e objetivos definidos pelas áreas de negócio;

  • Elaborar e manter a documentação detalhada de todas as soluções implementadas, incluindo descrições técnicas, mudanças realizadas e justificativas, para facilitar a manutenção, futuras atualizações e a consulta por outras equipes;

Procura & Negociação:


  • Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.


Análise & Gestão de Performance:


  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.
  • Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.


Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:


  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.


Liderança & Desenvolvimento:


  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.



Requisitos

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.

description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Senior Software Engineer – LLM / AI-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.


About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.


Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI,Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it throughautomated testing, CI/CD, and observability.


Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g.,measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse,Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, SalesforceCommunities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR/EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.


You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and weprovide mentorship and guidance as needed.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Facilitar cerimônias Scrum: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews e Retrospectives.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de PI (Program Increment).
  • Atuar como servant leader e coach para um ou mais times ágeis dentro de um SAFe Agile Release Train (ART).
  • Identificar e remover impedimentos que afetem o progresso do time.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes  Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Responsável pela implantação, suporte, análise e monitoramento dos serviços de comunicação das embarcações, no CEOP e Centro de treinamento e simulação (CTS), considerando TVRO (TV via satélite das embarcações), Redes VSAT (link GEO e LEO - Internet via satélite das embarcações), links STARLINK, CFTV (Circuito fechado de TV das embarcações), infraestrutura de redes (LAN e WAN) das embarcações, computadores e servidores a bordo, participação em projetos, objetivando garantir a disponibilidade e performance adequadas para os serviços suportados e mitigar perda de receita para a companhia.


Descrição detalhada:

1. Assegurar que os serviços de dados das embarcações estejam funcionando plenamente, através de manutenção dos serviços de dados de forma proativa por meio de monitoramento e atendimento a chamados abertos na ferramenta de helpdesk;


2. Garantir o funcionamento dos equipamentos de rede e VSAT (internet via satélite) das embarcações, através de atendimento presencial e remoto nas embarcações e monitoramento da qualidade dos serviços de dados prestados por terceiros;


3. Garantir atendimentos técnicos às embarcações (TVRO, VSAT, CFTV, rede LAN e WAN), através de monitoramento do cronograma de entrada das embarcações, acionamento das empresas responsáveis e acompanhamento do atendimento técnico e testes do sistema reparado;


4. Contribuir na criação e execução de novos projetos para implementação de novas tecnologias, por meio de analise e cronograma de implementação, verificando requisitos dos sistemas e participando da implementação técnica;


5. Assegurar a segurança dos dados do parque computacional das embarcações, por meio da utilização de software de gerenciamento da ferramenta de antivírus e teste das políticas no firewall de bordo;


6. Garantir a manutenção do sistema de câmeras a bordo das embarcações, através de acompanhamento do sistema de helpdesk para acionamento da manutenção dentro do SLA predefinido;


7. Analisar multas e downtimes, através de analise dos eventos de TI que causaram perda de receita com a finalidade de mitigar novos eventos similares;


8. Garantir a disseminação do conhecimento das tecnologias das embarcações (VSAT, TVRO, Antenas estabilizadas, CFTV, etc). Dividir conhecimento com a equipe de TI Operações de modo a aumentar a senioridade do corpo técnico, garantindo maior assertividade nos atendimentos;


9. Criar meios de monitoramento proativo dos serviços de TIC das embarcações, criar ferramentas e desenvolver meios de monitorar os ativos de rede das embarcações de forma a reparar o incidente de forma transparente ao cliente;


10. Estabelecer e manter dashboards e informes de gestão atualizados, através da atualização dos controles de projetos no project, mantendo pleno funcionamento do dashboard do monitoramento e gerar relatórios de acompanhamento de indicadores da área;


11. Assegurar as atividades de suporte níveis 3 aos usuários e ativos de TIC da frota, garantindo o bom funcionamento do ambiente operacional de TI das embarcações, garantindo pleno funcionamento das redes internas das embarcações, suas soluções de endpoint e tecnologias de Hyper-V dos servidores de bordo;


12. Cumprir e implementar as determinações estabelecidas pela companhia, na busca da melhoria da Qualidade, Segurança (Ocupacional e Operacional), Saúde e Proteção Ambiental, prevenção e combate à poluição e/ou eliminação das não conformidades, visando a excelência operacional.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Júnior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: Immigration Paralegal
description:
We are a boutique law firm focused on family immigration matters including but not limited to fiancé visas, family petitions, citizenship, asylum and deportation defense. We practice immigration law throughout the United States, as well as serving individuals abroad seeking to immigrate to the United States. Its founder Michael Mendez has dedicated his practice to solely immigration matters for over 18 years. Our firm culture focuses on individualized client attention, while using the latest technology to assure seamless and effective representation for our clients. As a firm comprised of first and second-generation immigrants, we can relate to the struggles one encounters during the immigration process and thus strive to use our expertise to achieve our clients' immigration goals. Here at Michael Mendez, P.A. we offer compassion, knowledge and the experience needed to attain the American Dream.

We are looking for a licensed attorney in Brazil to join our team to assist Attorney Mendez as well as our U.S. based attorneys and paralegals to communicate with clients directly, analyze, research and draft legal documentation associated with U.S. immigration cases. We are looking for someone who loves working with immigrants as much as we do! A successful candidate will have excellent writing, research and analytical skills to assume responsibility in an active and diverse immigration practice. An applicant must be fluent in English, Spanish. and Portuguese.

Your role will be to serve as a liaison between the attorneys of the firm and the client in order to facilitate a viable immigration application. This role requires excellent communication skills both via email and orally -- it is exceptionally important that we communicate with our clients in both a timely and effective manner. As you gain experience in the U.S. legal process you will have a greater role in devising the strategy to assist the attorneys to obtain approval for our clients.

Strong time management and organizational skills are essential to effectively handle the high-volume of cases with which you will be working. We are looking for an attorney who pays attention to detail, communicates exceptionally, has a positive attitude and strong work ethic. We are looking for someone who values the practice of law with purpose and that desires working at an immigration firm that changes the lives of our clients through innovative thinking and collaborative teamwork.

We are a growing full-service immigration firm that handles all types of family based and deportation defense related U.S. immigration cases

• Licensed Lawyer in Brazil, preferably with a strong focus on writing and research;

• 3+ years legal experience is strongly preferred but not required;

• Fluency in English, Spanish and Portugues.

• Exceptionally strong communication skills;

• Strong research and writing skills;

• Strong organizational skills, detail-oriented, and able to work well under deadlines.

Fully Remote 40 hours per week during standard business hours.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning

  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL


Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: Social Media Content Creator (Do Not Quick Apply)
description:
Brand Storyteller

(Full-Time Contractor · Remote · BestLyfe Group)

About the Role

BestLyfe Group (BLG) is on the hunt for a world-class Brand Storyteller — someone who lives and breathes content, strategy, and data. You’ll be the creative force behind the social presence of three powerhouse brands:

  • Dustin Lunde (our fearless founder)
  • Lyfe by the Horns (our unapologetically real podcast and brand)
  • BestLyfe Group (our marketing agency changing how businesses grow)

Your mission? Build authority, drive engagement, and make people feel something when they see our content. You’ll co-create strategy with leadership, manage execution across every platform, and bring the kind of creative energy that makes people stop scrolling and start following.

This isn’t a “post pretty graphics and call it a day” gig. This is brand building at its finest — story, psychology, timing, and metrics all rolled into one.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop and execute a holistic content strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Threads
  • Collaborate directly with leadership to create high-impact content campaigns for BLG, LBTH, and Dustin’s personal brand
  • Edit short- and long-form videos, design graphics, and produce thumb-stopping creative assets
  • Write witty, on-brand copy that captures our tone — bold, self-aware, real
  • Analyze performance data and adjust strategy to improve engagement, reach, and conversion
  • Manage posting schedules and platform optimizations
  • Repurpose content across platforms to maximize visibility and ROI
  • Collaborate with our current editor during the transition period for consistent quality and brand cohesion
Who You Are
  • A creative weapon — equal parts strategist, designer, editor, and storyteller
  • Obsessed with social media trends, but smart enough to know when to lead instead of follow
  • Fluent in Canva, Adobe Suite, or CapCut, and capable of building content that looks as good as it performs
  • Analytical enough to make data sexy — and creative enough to turn insights into action
  • A self-starter who thrives in autonomy, takes initiative, and communicates like a pro
  • Hungry, curious, and coachable — talent and drive matter more to us than titles or years of experience
The BLG Culture (Read Carefully)

We’re not looking for average.

Average doesn’t last here.

BLG is a no-BS, high-performance culture built on creativity, accountability, and excellence. We don’t do drama, excuses, or clock-watchers. We do bold ideas, ownership, and growth.

If you love creating, want to be part of something that’s actually going somewhere, and thrive under leadership that challenges and believes in you — you’ll fit right in.

If you need hand-holding, constant direction, or approval for every idea — this isn’t your gig.

Why BLG

Because we’re building something real.

You’ll work directly with the founder, get exposure to multiple brands, and have the freedom to test, create, and evolve — all while being part of a team that’s redefining what marketing should feel like.

How to Apply

Think you’ve got what it takes? Prove it.

title: Lead SRE Engineer

We’re seeking an experienced Lead Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing team in Brazil. In this role, you’ll partner with product teams to tackle critical infrastructure challenges, acting as both a hands-on technical expert and a mentor.

Must Have

  • Managing production-critical systems with deep knowledge of SRE and DevOps principles .

  • Expertise with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience managing and debugging Redis and Postgres databases.
  • Solid understanding of VPCs, VPNs, load balancers, and cloud networking .
  • Proficiency with Git , branching strategies, and CI/CD integrations.
  • Strong grasp of web and network protocols (HTTP, REST, TLS, DNS, etc.).


Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • Familiarity with ArgoCD , GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Working knowledge of Python , Golang , and Helm .
  • Experience running scalable Node.js microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure security and Terragrunt best practices.
  • Background in production readiness and high-growth engineering environments .


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações (AHTS)


Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.


Descrição Resumida:


Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações para atuar na gestão de contratos e desempenho da frota offshore, com foco em embarcações do tipo AHTS. Será responsável por garantir a eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, controle de custos e relacionamento com o cliente. Experiência direta com AHTS será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito eliminatório.


Descrição Detalhada:


1. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos internos, contratuais e legais no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio do acompanhamento das atividades operacionais e da atuação no gerenciamento dos processos, incluindo estabelecimento de ações preventivas e corretivas;


2. Assegurar a manutenção da operacionalidade da frota de embarcações, por meio da participação nos processos de planejamento, decisão e interface com o cliente e interação com os departamentos de suporte quando necessário (suprimentos, manutenção, engenharia, QSMS e RH marítimo);


3. Aumentar a eficiência, rentabilidade e segurança da operação da frota de embarcações, por meio do acompanhamento dos indicadores de desempenho, da realização de análises críticas e indicação e desenvolvimento de projetos de melhorias para os processos, através do estreito relacionamento com o departamento de QSMS a fim de garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança e procedimentos internos da companhia, assim como atuação no processo de investigação de acidentes;


4. Garantir atendimento e satisfação dos clientes, por meio de um bom relacionamento, conhecimento dos requisitos estabelecidos, acompanhamento dos índices de avaliação de desempenho, realização de análises críticas desses resultados e indicação de melhorias para os processos, assim como estar atento a tendência e projetos de melhoria para maior satisfação ao cliente;


5. Assegurar o cumprimento do orçamento de custos e receitas da gerência de operações, por meio da participação nos processos de orçamento, análise crítica dos resultados e indicação de ações preventivas e corretivas, assim como emissão de relatórios de medição do serviço e reembolso, acompanhamento do processo até o pagamento junto com o setor financeiro;


6. Preservar a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e parceiros, bem como a preservação ambiental, no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio da participação nos processos de análise de riscos, definição de medidas de controle, elaboração de procedimentos e fornecimento de orientações;


7. Apoiar no desenvolvimento da equipe, por meio de planejamento e acompanhamento do Planejamento de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), a fim de conduzir o crescimento dentro da organização;


8. Assegurar retorno a operacionalidade das embarcações em situações de downtime, através de coordenação das necessidades da embarcação e negociação com cliente com o objetivo de reverter o downtime com a menor perda possível de faturamento, assim como a execução e envio de relatórios técnicos ao cliente;


9. Controlar e garantir atendimento das ações e pendências com o cliente e órgãos reguladores, acompanhamento do processo no sistema SISPEN, GINSP (PETROBRAS), controle de cartas, agrupando as informações de todas as áreas envolvidas;


10. Coordenar os projetos de conversão/modificação das embarcações para estejam de acordo com os requisitos contratados pelo cliente, planejando junto as áreas de apoio (Engenharia, Suprimentos e Docagem) todas as entregas relacionadas a projeto, materiais e obra da embarcação dentro do prazo e atendendo ao escopo solicitado;


11. Cumprir e implementar as determinações estabelecidas pela companhia, na busca da melhoria da Qualidade, Segurança (Ocupacional e Operacional), Saúde e Proteção Ambiental, prevenção e combate à poluição e/ou eliminação das não conformidades, visando a excelência operacional.


Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa (Engenharias, Náutica, Administração ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência anterior em operações offshore ou gestão de frotas marítimas;
  • Conhecimento sólido dos requisitos contratuais e regulatórios do setor;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de indicadores, orçamento e relacionamento com clientes;
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes multidisciplinares, com foco em resultados e segurança

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Position: Salesforce Developer – Revenue Technology

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6+ Months

About the Role

Asana’s Enterprise Technology team is seeking a Salesforce Developer with a passion for learning, a drive to take projects from concept to completion, and a talent for solving complex challenges with elegant solutions. This role is ideal for someone experienced in Salesforce development who’s ready to build scalable processes that enhance operational efficiency across the company, with a strong emphasis on Service Cloud and Customer Community (Experience Cloud) solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support teams to understand business goals and design effective Salesforce solutions.
  • Design, develop, and customize Service Cloud features including case management, service console, knowledge base, and omni-channel routing.
  • Implement and enhance Customer Community (Experience Cloud) portals to improve self-service capabilities, user engagement, and customer experience.
  • Partner with developers and project managers on the Business Systems team to deliver high-impact initiatives.
  • Build and enhance revenue attribution, pipeline automation, and approval workflows.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code with strong unit test coverage.
  • Develop scalable tooling frameworks to ensure consistent, high-quality releases.
  • Manage shifting priorities in a dynamic environment while delivering impactful solutions.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategic roadmap for Salesforce architecture and implementation.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS/CIS, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Proven expertise in Salesforce Service Cloud and Customer Community (Experience Cloud) implementations.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer.
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce APIs, SOAP/REST web services, and SOQL.
  • Experience with GitHub, Jenkins, Copado, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and enterprise integration frameworks.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, multi-priority environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II.
